title: Great couples massage!
text:
The staff is incredibly kind and made us feel very welcome on our couples retreat to Spain. The massage was much needed after many days walking abroad in the city and the ritual spa was very refreshing.
The spa is very well decorated and made us feel welcome. 
Thank you to the staff—the comic book decor was very fun!
